metadata.scenario: A returning patient calls to book their regular weekly physical therapy session. They want Thursday at 3 PM as usual. The receptionist confirms the appointment. Quick, routine call.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is David Anderson. I’m calling to schedule my wife’s physical therapy session. Hi David! Great to hear from you. When would you like to book the appointment? We’d like to stick with Thursday at 3 PM, just like usual. Absolutely, let me check that for you. (pause) Yes, I see that Dr. Rodriguez is available at that time. I can confirm that for you. That’s perfect. Thank you! You're welcome! Just to confirm, that’s Thursday at 3 PM with Dr. Rodriguez. Yes, that’s correct. Great! I’ll send you a reminder text the day before. I appreciate that. Also, how does the medication management service work? Our medication management includes reminders, organization, and supervision of administration. That sounds helpful. What’s the price for that service? It ranges from $65 to $80 per session, typically lasting about 30 to 45 minutes. I’d like to consider that for my wife. Absolutely! I can have one of our care coordinators follow up with you about details. Yes, please do that. Okay, I'll ask Lisa Chen to reach out to you. Her direct number is +13165559203. Great, thanks! Is there anything else I can assist you with today, David? No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help! You’re welcome! We look forward to seeing your wife on Thursday. Thank you, Margaret. Have a good day! You too, David. Take care!
